mechanism: Open on one unmistakably extraordinary but original visitor at a familiar domestic threshold. Preserve the same identity anchors across a one-way daytime route of at least four visually different mundane responsibilities. Each chapter must contain one familiar tool or exchange, one complete action and one visible result; surrounding people and environments respond normally rather than explaining the visitor. Use object or hand-state handoffs to keep the montage causal, then change the time of day once and return the visitor to the opening boundary for a restrained final acknowledgment. The reusable mechanism is extraordinary identity normalized by cumulative ordinary competence and a same-place day return—not the source alien design, suburban house, car, service window, drink, grill, manicure, garden, clothing, exact tasks, camera positions, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one original extraordinary visitor at an ordinary threshold before the route begins.
invariants.purpose: Creates an immediate contrast question without requiring exposition.
invariants.ablation_failure: A conventional subject removes the normalization tension; a random location removes the social baseline.

invariants.rule: Keep the same identity anchors across at least four non-repeating mundane tasks.
invariants.purpose: Turns the premise into a coherent day rather than a novelty reel.
invariants.ablation_failure: Identity drift or repeated duties break cumulative familiarity.

invariants.rule: Give every task one familiar tool or exchange, a complete action and a visible result.
invariants.purpose: Lets the audience understand competence without narration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Poses or incomplete motions leave only costume spectacle.

invariants.rule: Let the world respond normally and avoid explaining the visitor's origin.
invariants.purpose: Normalization is produced through behavior and social acceptance.
invariants.ablation_failure: Exposition or panic changes the mechanism into lore or threat.

invariants.rule: Use one day-to-night transition and return to the opening boundary with a restrained acknowledgment.
invariants.purpose: Converts multiple errands into a bounded daily loop.
invariants.ablation_failure: A random final location leaves the route episodic and unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source gray alien head, eyes, body proportions, shirt, hands and exact greeting performance
the source suburban porch, car interior, road, drive-through window, drink and payment exchange
the source grill, meat, manicure interaction, garden hose, plants and residential night background
the source shot order, lenses, framing, lighting progression, exact 30-second rhythm and transitions
the source creator identity, platform overlay, watermark, model claim and branding
